reason: An evidence-driven operations bundle for agent workflow planning, bounded local memory search, repository and release audits, benchmark gating, and runtime checks, with an explicitly invoked guarded hotfix as its only described mutation.

summaries.zh: 面向智能体运维的证据驱动工具包，用于生成工作流与发布计划、搜索受限本地上下文、审计仓库状态并检查插件和运行时配置。
summaries.en: An evidence-driven operations toolkit for agent workflow and release planning, bounded local context search, repository audits, and plugin and runtime checks.

capabilities: Read configured local Markdown and code roots for bounded memory searches
Inspect Git cleanliness, untracked files, and credential-like paths
Generate workflow plans, release checklists, and benchmark evidence gates
Verify plugin packaging and runtime prompt compatibility
Apply an explicit guarded terminal hotfix when separately invoked
